correctness.rationale: Exact K_s reproducing-kernel evaluation yields F=((1-r²)/(1-conj(w)phi(w)))^s. Schwarz–Pick gives a strict global gap away from w=0, eliminating remote branches near value 1. With phi(z)=az+bz^{m+1}+O(z^{m+2}), a rotated radial coordinate is uniformly invertible, and its transverse leading term is a full angular harmonic with coefficient s|b|/(s|1-a|)^{1+m/2}, yielding both endpoints and the half-width. The tangent-cone convexity contradiction and the published scalar classification cover all symbol types. Bounded monomial realizers have squared norm ratios gamma_k/gamma_{dk}|c|^{2k}, which are finite and asymptotic to d^{1-s}|c|^{2k}.
